label: Trained logistic PA challenger research; development only; no production or betting claim

populations.fit: 2023 primary rows (105,225; truncated excluded; label+features only)
populations.eval: 2024 E1 (55,815) and E2 (50,252) primary rows, identical across arms, ONE evaluation

arms.L0: P3-log5 (promoted Phase 6 baseline): 2024 = pitcher_prior P3_l5; 2023 = same formula from counts
arms.L1a: logit(p) = a + 1*logit(p_L0)  (offset fixed, intercept only) - PRE-REGISTERED both modes
arms.L1b: logit(p) = a + b*logit(p_L0)  (both estimated) - PRE-REGISTERED both modes; b-mode PRIMARY
arms.L2: logit(p) = a + b*logit(p_L0) + g'x, ridge logistic on standardized x
arms.L3: L2 + trip dummies (2,3,4+) + starter_pa_index/9 linear (pre-registered limited interactions)

F3_pitcher_discipline: contact_rate_std* (* joined from pitcher_rolling; both windows included by pre-registration; no per-window post-hoc selection)

excluded_families: repertoire/velocity/movement (prior lift failed + schema drift risk)
k_rate level (baseline input; excluded to avoid double-counting)

uses: C grid {0.01,0.03,0.1,0.3,1,3} selection (mean fold eval logloss)
family ablation (drop-one mean fold eval logloss delta)
OOF permutation importance (20 perms/family, joint column permutation, mean eval logloss increase across folds)

regularization: L2 ridge, sklearn lbfgs, standardized on training fold; L1 arms C=1e6
metrics: paired date-cluster bootstrap (B=2000, seed=0) vs L0
oracle start-level MAE/RMSE/bias + paired bootstraps for promoted arm vs L0
promotion_gates: beats L0 PA logloss in BOTH E1 and E2
